request.work_event_id: lowercase canonical PostgreSQL UUID; all hexadecimal version/variant bits accepted
request.credit_invoice_line_id: Optional lower canonical UUID from genuine selected native credited row; absence is allowed only when there is exactly one linked credit for an eligible CREDITED action.

actor: actor_user_id is injected from the authenticated current Worker user; payload is exactly schema_version/work_event_id plus optional credit_invoice_line_id; null is not an optional selected ID.
requiredRole: Current active Office payment actor: admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key; service-only native entry plus actual group/client/current covering-export VIEW_PAY_WORK scope
credit_lines: Array of closed {invoice_line_id:uuid}, genuine linked IDs only for the existing writer CAS; no invoice ID, amount, reference or document is exposed
facts_fingerprint: lowercase hex64 | null; use unchanged as expected_facts_fingerprint for the existing strict KEEP_AS_PAID writer

latest_acknowledgement.acknowledgement_sequence: positive canonical decimal string <=9223372036854775807; never convert to JavaScript Number
latest_acknowledgement.meaning: Latest genuine event ACK is selected before current reason/hash comparison and stays visible when historical; decision_applies alone states its current applicability

buttonEnabled: decision_available === true AND decision_needed === true AND disabled_reason === null; reason must be one of the two exact values and facts_fingerprint must be present
readCurrentness: Fresh complete genuine CURRENT export, or actual current successful APPLIED correction export, covers the original event/group/client/date; raw present/unfinalised is never inferred absent. No current Source pay head or root proof means decision_available false. Unsupported ordinary-source omission remains unavailable until its genuine producer is delivered.

values.CURRENT_SOURCE_PAY_BASIS_UNAVAILABLE: The current Source pay basis is not yet available. Refresh this shift before deciding.
values.SOURCE_PRESENT: This shift is present in the latest source file.
values.ACCEPTED_SOURCE_REMOVED: Source hours have already been accepted for this shift.
values.CURRENT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT: Keep as paid is already recorded for these Source facts.
values.SOURCE_FACTS_UNAVAILABLE: The current Source facts are not yet available. Refresh this shift before deciding.
values.NO_DECISION_REQUIRED: No Keep as paid decision is needed for these Source facts.
values.CREDIT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Open the credited Source line before recording Keep as paid.

unknowns: paid and decision_needed/holds may be null; preserve null. An ACK, invoice, head or absent export does not prove paid cash, withheld money, recovery or a Bank cut.
runtimeDecoder: kept-pay-context.mjs decodeKeptPayContext(value, requestPayload); preserve all returned scalar types and nulls.
selectedCredit: An exact genuine request credit ID must belong to returned credit_lines. When exactly one returned credit exists, its actual ID may populate the existing writer; multiple returned IDs require native selected row, never first/sorted choice. An empty list never admits CREDITED.
